title: The Directions to the Hidden Step
youtube_title: The Directions to the Hidden Step | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A story belongs to the person still speaking it.
summary: At a library window seat, the ferryman begins to tell Tamsin about directions to a step that was easy to miss. Tamsin wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
